dt2.12:1.3: Saṃkhārakkhandhena ye dhammā sampayuttā te dhammā katīhi khandhehi katīhāyatanehi katīhi dhātūhi saṃgahītā.
dt2.12:1.4: Te dhammā tīhi khandhehi divīhāyatanehi aṭṭhahi dhātūhi saṃgahītā.
dt2.12:1.6: Dvīhi khandhehi dasahāyatanehi dasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā. Dhātuk_XII.2
dt2.12:2.5: Maṇo-viññāṇa-dhātuyā ye dhamma sampayuttā te dhammā . . . pe . . . .
dt2.12:2.6: Tīhi khandhehi ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā saṃgahītā.
dt2.12:2.8: Dvīhi khandhehi ekādasahi āyatanehi sattarasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā. Dhātuk_XII.3
dt2.12:3.3: te dhammā . . . pe . . . . Catuhi khandhehi dvīhāyatanehi dvīhi dhātūhi saṃgahītā.

dt2.12:21.1: Sukhāya vedanāya sampayuttehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:21.2: Dukkhāya vedanāya sampayuttehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:21.3: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya sampayuttehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:21.9: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Ekena khandhena ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā asaṃgahītā.
dt2.12:21.11: Catuhi khandhehi ekādasahi āyatanehi sattarasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā. Dhātuk_XII.21
dt2.12:22.2: Hetu c'eva sahetukehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:22.4: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Catuhi khandhehi dvīhāyatanehi dvīhi dhātūhi saṃgahītā.
dt2.12:22.6: Ekena khandhena dasahāyatanehi soḷasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā -- Sahetukā c'eva na ca hetuhi dhammehi ye dhammā -- Hetu-sampayuttā c'eva na ca hetuhi dhammehi ye dhammā -- Na hetu
dt2.12:23.4: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Ekena khandhena ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā saṃgahītā.
dt2.12:23.6: Catuhi khandhehi ekādasahi āyatanehi sattarasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā. Dhātuk_XII.22
dt2.12:24.2: Āsavā c'eva sāsavehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:24.3: Āsavā c'eva āsava-sampayuttehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā
dt2.12:24.4: te dhammā . . . pe . . .? Catuhi khandhehi dvīhāyatanehi dvīhi dhātūhi saṃgahīta.
dt2.12:24.6: Ekena khandhena dasahāyatanehi soḷasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā. Dhātuk_XII.23

dt2.12:30.3: Kilesā c'eva saṃkilesikehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:30.4: Kilesā c'eva saṃkiliṭṭhehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:30.5: Kilesā c'eva kilesa-sampayuttehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā
dt2.12:30.6: te dhammā. . . . pe . . .? Catuhi khandhehi dvihāyatanehi dvīhi dhātūhi saṃgahītā.
dt2.12:30.8: Ekena khandhena dasahāyatanehi soḷasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā. Dhātuk_XII.29
dt2.12:31.1: Saṃkilesā c'eva no ca kilesehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:31.2: Kilesa-sampayuttā c'eva no ca kilesehi dhammehi ye dhammā --
dt2.12:31.8: Upekhā-sahagatehi dhammehi ye dhammā sampayuttā te dhammā katīhi khandhehi katīhāyatanehi katīhi dhātūhi saṃgahītā?
dt2.12:31.9: Te dhammā ekena khandhena ekenāyatanena ekāya dhātuyā saṃgahītā.
dt2.12:31.11: Catuhi khandhehi ekādasahi āyatanehi sattarasahi dhātūhi asaṃgahītā.
